verses.1: The feast of the poor was called Passover.
verses.2: And the high priests and the officials wondered how he could be saved, for they were afraid of the people.
verses.3: Then Satan entered Judea, where there lived a man named Iskariot. He was one of the twelve disciples.
verses.4: And after he left, he told the high priests and generals how he wanted them to treat him.
verses.5: And they also agreed to give him silver as compensation.
verses.6: And he also explained the situation, and sought an opportunity to hand him over to the crowd.
verses.7: And the day of sacrifice came; it was time to offer sacrifices.
verses.8: And he sent Peter and John, saying, “Prepare for us the meal we will eat.”
verses.9: But they said to him, “What do you want me to prepare?”
verses.10: He said to them, “See, when you enter the city, a man will come to meet you and carry water in a container. Follow him into the house where he lives.”
verses.11: And you should also pay the landlord of the house. The teacher says to you, “Where is the place where I can eat my meals after teaching with my students?”
verses.12: The same one will show you a great ascension. That’s where you must prepare yourself.
verses.13: When they left, they found him there as he had said. They prepared for the feast.
verses.14: And when that hour came, even the apostles fell down along with him.
verses.15: And he said to them, “I desired very much to eat this food with you before I suffer.”
verses.16: I say to you that I will not eat it until it is paid for in the kingdom of God.
verses.17: And after thanking him for the drink, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves.”
verses.18: I say to you, do not be afraid from now on, from the time when the wine was made until the kingdom of God comes.
verses.19: And after taking the bread and giving thanks, he said to them, “This is my offering for you. Do this as a reminder of me.”
verses.20: And the cup should be used after eating, saying, “This is the new covenant in my blood, which I offer for you.”
verses.21: In addition, I saw the hand of the one who gave it, placed on the table along with mine.
verses.22: Because the son of a man follows a certain path, except for those things that are given to him by the human being through whom he is delivered.
verses.23: And they began to discuss among themselves who of them would be the one who would carry out this task.
verses.24: And there was also a sense of competition among them; they wanted to see who of them was the best.
verses.25: And he said to them: “The kings of the nations rule over them, and those who exercise control over them are called ‘helpful ones’.”
verses.26: But you do not act in that manner. Instead, I should become more like the younger ones among you, and those who are considered to be “servants” should behave more like those who serve others.
verses.27: Which one is greater, the one who is fallen, or the one who serves? No, it’s not the one who is fallen. I am in the middle of you; I’m like the one who serves.
verses.28: We are those who have been tested along with me during my trials.
verses.29: I offer this to you, as my father has given me the kingdom.
verses.30: So that you may sit at my table in my kingdom, and drink from my cups. And you may sit on the throne to judge Israel’s twelve tribes.
verses.31: Simon Simon, behold, the Satan has caused you to think that it is the truth.
verses.32: I also wanted to ask for your help, so that your faith wouldn’t be lost. And when you return, I will support your brothers.
verses.33: And he said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you, whether into prison or to death.”
verses.34: But he said, “I tell you, Peter, today no one will be able to say anything brave until he has refuted me three times.”
verses.35: And he said to them, “When I sent you away as a little flock, did any of you turn back? But they replied, “No.”
verses.36: He said to them, “Now, those who have a balfon, they will be happy; they will also receive rewards. And those who do not have a balfon, they will have to sell their skin and buy soap instead.”
verses.37: I say to you that what is written here must be completed by me. But he rejected it based on incorrect reasoning. After all, the end of it lies with me.
verses.38: But they said, “Lord, look, there are two arrows here.” But he replied to them, “It is acceptable.”
verses.39: And after leaving, he went along according to the custom, towards the Mountains of Oil. His disciples followed him as well.
verses.40: And when he arrived at that place, he said to them, “Pray not to go into temptation.”
verses.41: And he also separated himself from them, like a stone that is thrown away. His knees were also bent down.
verses.42: He said, “Father, if he wants to take this cup away from me, then let him do so. But not my wish should be obeyed; his wish should be respected.”
verses.43: But a messenger from heaven came to him, strengthening him.
verses.44: And as the battle continued, his actions became even more intense. And it happened that the dust from his actions rose to the surface of the earth.
verses.45: And when they came out of their prayers, they found the disciples asleep, overcome with sorrow.
verses.46: And he said to them, “What are you waiting for? Rise up and pray, so that you may not enter into temptation.”
verses.47: While he was still speaking, the crowd saw him. Among those twelve men, one was called Judas. He rushed forward and tried to kiss Jesus.
verses.48: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, have you given up the son of man for a little price?”
verses.49: And those who were around him said, “Lord, shall we fight with swords?”
verses.50: And one of them selected a slave from among those of the high priest, and gave him his right hand.
verses.51: Then Jesus replied, “Wait until then.” And after touching the wound, he healed him.
verses.52: And Jesus said to the priests, commanders of the temple, and elders who were present there: “Why did you come here with swords and sticks, along with stones?”
verses.53: Every day, when I am with you in the temple, you do not place your hands on me. But this is your time and your authority over me.
verses.54: They then brought him in and took him into the house of the high priest. Peter followed from a distance.
verses.55: And while they were surrounded by flames in the middle of the hall, Peter sat down in the middle of them.
verses.56: And when someone saw him as a child, sitting in front of the light, they said to him, “Is this the same person who was with them?”
verses.57: But he refused to say anything. “I don’t know him, woman.”
verses.58: And after a short silence, he said to him: “And you too are one of them.” But Peter replied, “Man, I am not.”
verses.59: And there was also a man who claimed to be another person, saying, “In truth, this man was with him too. After all, he was a Galilean.”
verses.60: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you’re talking about.” And as he continued to speak, Alekto interrupted him with an exclamation.
verses.61: And the Lord looked at Peter with a sad expression on his face. Peter remembered what the Lord said to him: “Today, you must say three times ‘Prayer of Alatea’.”
verses.62: And when he stepped outside, he spoke in a bitter tone.
verses.63: And those men who continued to accompany him also mocked him.
verses.64: And they surrounded him, saying, “Prophesy, who is the one who has deceived you?”
verses.65: And many others, in a mocking manner, said things about him.
verses.66: And on the day appointed, the elders of the people gathered together, along with the priests and the scribes. They took him to their assembly.
verses.67: They said, “Are you indeed the Christ?” He replied to them, “If I tell you that I am not the Christ, then believe me.”
verses.68: But if I ask, do not answer.
verses.69: From now on, the son of man will be seated to the right of God’s power.
verses.70: And they all said, “So are you the son of God?” But he replied to them, “You say that I am. But who says that I am?”
verses.71: But they said, “What further testimony do we need?” For we had heard it from his own mouth.
